resources.string: Generated each launch and never stored, so events can be linked within a session but not to a user or device.
log() returns immediately. Each event is written to disk, then sent in a batch once batchSize events are pending or after debounceInterval passes without a new one.
Pending events are also sent when the app moves to the background and on the next launch. Failed sends are retried automatically.
Lists events waiting to be sent and events sent since launch, with everything each one is sent with.
